column4: If the aggregate initial principal amount of the notes is $914,150,000, the fair value calculation assumed that when the allocation between the Class A-2 Notes is determined on or before the date of pricing, the maximum amount of Class A-2-A Notes that would be issued is $327,480,000 (in which case, $0 of Class A-2-B Notes would be issued) and the minimum amount of the Class A-2-A Notes that would be issued is $81,870,000 (in which case $245,610,000 of Class A-2-B Notes would be issued).
